journey.name: send from single bitcoin balance
journey.description: Requires a funded primary wallet and a separate regtest wallet that can provide a valid unified request without a bgnq direct-funding field. Pair a hardware wallet to exercise source selection; it remains a separate device. This Android primary-node flow is not implemented on iOS yet.

actions.action: Scan a unified Bitcoin and Lightning request from the separate wallet and open the send amount screen
Verify the selected source is labeled Bitcoin and the amount row is labeled Available without Savings or Spending labels
Repeat on a compact 360 by 640 dp viewport, verify Continue is fully visible below the keypad and above the navigation bar, and tap its center; verify confirmation uses the unchanged entered amount
If a hardware wallet is paired, open the source selector and verify exactly one Bitcoin source (testTag "SendFundingSourceBitcoin") plus the separate hardware wallet entry
Select the software Bitcoin source and continue to confirmation; verify the From field says Bitcoin
Cancel the send and verify no payment was initiated
